- Claude quota recovery now retains a prior successful reading as a last-known quota and shows its actual successful observation time as Last checked.
- Failed Claude refreshes expose only typed, allowlisted safe reasons; an initial failure shows Quota unavailable without inventing a value, reset, or timestamp.
- View Claude usage opens exactly https://claude.ai/settings/usage only after an explicit click. This release does not add automatic authentication renewal, token refresh, browser-cookie import, or a Needlbar-owned auth flow.
- Claude API and OpenAI API billing links remain explicit official browser links only: https://platform.claude.com/settings/billing and https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/overview. They do not retrieve, parse, or display API balances automatically.
- Earlier isolated Claude API balance feasibility tooling remains review-only and is not production balance integration; it does not establish native authentication, session reuse, organization qualification, or amount extraction.
- No live authentication or installed-app acceptance was performed for the passive quota fallback change. Codex, Cursor, local usage, refresh cadence, signing, and security boundaries remain unchanged.
